conciseReport:
# TEST2-88 — Automobile MS Teams Call display settings

Nine criteria passed, one failed and two were blocked. The active legend and display popover exposed no colouring-mode choice, preventing the configured colouring selection check. Independent Preston comparisons demonstrated detailed route traces, linked sites, linked cells and both zoom/site prerequisites. The final isolation criterion was blocked when authentication expired during a host interruption; the permitted launcher retry did not recover the session. No sign-in controls, backend writes or request interception were used. The last test-created MS Teams layer and its map position could not be restored after authentication loss. Earlier temporary layer visibility changes were restored and test-created layers removed between completed criteria. Independent evidence review is still required.
reason: Executed the selected Automobile MS Teams Call handoff. Missing colouring selection and the final authentication blocker are recorded per criterion. No simulation was used. Browser cleanup was complete between criteria 3–11; the final criterion's test-created MS Teams layer could not be removed after sign-in redirected outside the authenticated application. No interception was installed. The browser lease is released after staging.

cleanup.limitation: Authentication loss during criterion 12 prevented removal of its test-created MS Teams layer and restoration of the final Preston map view; existing Download layer/detail was retained.
